 Torino-Monza, fans respond: pre-sales soar! Torino fans out in force! 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article TICKET SALES BOOM: EXCITEMENT AFTER THE WIN OVER PARMA
 Two wins in a row have sent spirits soaring and reignited the spark. Advance ticket sales for the early league fixture against Monza tomorrow, Friday, October 23 , are moving at a remarkable pace, with more than 20,000 spectators already set to attend.
 A sign of unconditional love and tremendous faith in Ignazio Abate 's team. The Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino is getting ready for a big occasion, with a wave of passionate support set to drive the players forward from the very first minute. Credit also goes to the Granata club's well-judged promotional offers, such as the excellent-value "2+2 Offer" available in the Curve and Distinti sections, which is encouraging huge numbers of friends and families to fill the stadium.
 OneFootball Videos
 BIG-MATCH NUMBERS: HOW SALES COMPARE WITH PREVIOUS GAMES
 The response from Torino fans to this fixture has far exceeded even the most optimistic expectations, with attendance figures usually seen only for marquee clashes against traditional giants such as Inter, Roma or Juventus. The 20,000 mark has already been passed, and reaching 22,000 by kick-off is now a realistic target.
 Olimpico Ticketing Focus What is the "2+2 Offer" available for Torino-Monza? 
 The Torino-Monza 2+2 Offer allows anyone buying two full-price tickets in the Curva Maratona, Curva Primavera or Distinti sections to add another two for the special price of just €10 each .
 Where can you buy the remaining tickets for the match? 
 The best option is to buy online through the Official Torino FC Website to avoid queues, paying by credit card or Satispay, or through authorized Vivaticket outlets.
 Is a good turnout of away fans from Monza expected? 
 Yes, tickets for the away section at the Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino are on general sale for Monza supporters making the trip to Piedmont for Serie A matchday 8.
